issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: cauldron, cornflower, brewing_stand, allium, candle, brick_stairs, white_wall_banner.
415 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Window boxes with trapdoor fronts, a slab door canopy with two hanging lanterns, candles, flower pots, a white carpet aisle and chain-hung lanterns over the ward.
notes.purpose: Brewing stand and cauldron by the beds and the white banner over the door make it read as a place of healing.
notes.depth: Window boxes and the canopy help the front, but the side and back walls are still one flat plane.
notes.roof: Same roof as L1; overhang warning is a false alarm (1 block all round). Gap under the front ridge at (5,6,1) remains.
notes.life: Flowers in boxes and lanterns at the door; no ground planting yet.

visual.summary: L1 plus brewing stand and cauldron, candles, hanging lanterns, window boxes, a door canopy and a banner: the ward now looks lived in and its purpose shows from the door.
problems: Front barge board hole under the ridge at (5,6,1) carried over from L1.
Side (x=2, x=8) and back walls stay flat; only the east-side window box at (9,1,4) breaks them.
Reachability: ward, aisle and lean-to reached; unreached are only roof slopes, window-box tops (3,2,1),(7,2,1),(9,2,4), the canopy top and shelf tops. Fine.

notes.purpose: Brewing stand, cauldron and six red beds make the job clear inside, but Carlton's red cross is not visible: the banner at (5,4,1) renders as a plain white banner. Its red cross exists only as a decoration-step note (banner_pattern) that the structure file and the renders do not show, and that is not builder-tested.
notes.artefacts: Carlton's note on v1 ('Add a red cross or something to show that its a hospital') is not met: the cross is only a decoration-step note in the generator, banners render plain white (the Studio file can't carry banner patterns). RUBRIC: a version that ignores one of his notes can't pass 'No mistakes'. Build the cross from blocks on the front gable
notes.detail: Window boxes, door canopy with lanterns, candles, flower pots, carpet aisle and hanging lanterns.
notes.depth: Side (x=2, x=8) and back walls are still flat apart from the east window box.
notes.roof: One-block overhang and barge boards; the automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm.
notes.levels: Adds a clear new job (brewing corner) and a dressed front (canopy, boxes, banner) over L1.

visual.summary: L1 plus a brewing corner, candles, lanterns, flower boxes, a door canopy and a front banner. The barge-board hole is fixed, but the red cross Carlton asked for does not show: the banner is plain white.
problems: Red cross not visible: the white_wall_banner at (5,4,1) shows plain white; the cross is only a decoration-step note. Build the cross in blocks so it shows in renders and in game without the decoration step, e.g. red_wool/red_concrete plus on the front gable face at (5,4..6,2),(4,5,2),(6,5,2) with white blocks at (4,4,2),(6,4,2); move or drop the banner at (5,4,1) so it does not cover it.
Side and back walls still flat; optional.
Reachability: ward, aisle and lean-to reached; unreached are only roof slopes, window-box tops (3,2,1),(7,2,1),(9,2,4), the canopy top at (4..6,4,1) and shelf tops. Fine.
